S25.01.needs: a PDF file in the Library
S25.01.note: The PDF reader is an iframe with test id library-pdf-reader and no visible label; the row opens the viewer only when the file is previewable.
steps: Sign in, then click Library in the sidebar.
Click the Documents tab.
Click a PDF file row.
Look for the in-app PDF reader filling the viewer, instead of a download.
S25.01.where: Sidebar > Library > Documents > click a PDF row

S25.02.needs: a plain-text file in the Library
S25.02.note: The Library text view is a plain pre block (FileTextPreview.tsx). A separate viewer under Project settings also shows text (FilePreviewModal.tsx).
steps: Sign in, then click Library in the sidebar.
Click the Documents tab.
Click a plain-text file row.
Look for the text shown in a readable preformatted block inside the viewer.
S25.02.where: Sidebar > Library > Documents > click a .txt row

S25.03.needs: a project with a Markdown file in Files
S25.03.note: The Library viewer shows Markdown as plain text, not formatted. The control that opens Project settings was not found in the code, so the step to open it is unverified.
steps: Click Projects in the sidebar and open a project that has a Markdown file in its Files.
Open its Project settings dialog and scroll to the section titled Files.
Click Preview on the Markdown file row.
Look for headings and formatting rendered as Markdown, not raw # and ** characters.
S25.03.where: Projects > open a project > Project settings > Files > Preview <file name>

S25.04.needs: a project with a source-code file in Files
S25.04.note: The code view is in FilePreviewModal.tsx; the Library text view does not colour syntax. The path to Project settings is unverified.
steps: Click Projects in the sidebar and open a project that has a source-code file in its Files.
Open its Project settings dialog and go to the section titled Files.
Click Preview on the source-code file row.
Look for the code shown with syntax colouring for its language.
S25.04.where: Projects > open a project > Project settings > Files > Preview <file name>

S25.05.needs: an image file in the Library
steps: Sign in, then click Library in the sidebar.
Click the Images tab.
Click an image row.
Look for the image shown in the viewer with its file name as the alt text and a zoom group in the top bar.
S25.05.where: Sidebar > Library > Images > click an image row

S25.07.needs: a video file in the Library
steps: Sign in, then click Library in the sidebar.
Click the Videos tab.
Click a video row.
Look for a video player with playback controls in the viewer, and press play.
S25.07.where: Sidebar > Library > Videos > click a video row

S25.08.needs: a spreadsheet file in the Library
S25.08.note: The table is drawn in FileTextPreview.tsx; the Project settings > Files preview also reaches it. The Library path is inferred from code, not traced to a spreadsheet type.
steps: Sign in, then click Library in the sidebar.
Click the Documents tab.
Click a spreadsheet file row (for example .xlsx or .csv).
Look for the sheet shown as a table with a header row and data rows.
S25.08.where: Sidebar > Library > Documents > click a spreadsheet row

S25.10.note: The text is extracted on the server (file-text-preview.ts), so layout and images are not kept.
steps: Sign in, then click Library in the sidebar.
Click the Documents tab.
Click a Word (.docx) file row.
Look for the document text shown in the viewer, formatted as text.
S25.10.where: Sidebar > Library > Documents > click a .docx row

S25.14.needs: an image file in the Library
S25.14.note: Zoom appears only for images; the group has no visible label, only an aria-label of Zoom.
steps: Open an image from Library > Images as in S25.05.
Look at the top bar of the viewer for the group labelled Zoom with the percentage shown.
Click Zoom in and Zoom out, and watch the percentage and the image size change.
Look for the buttons to stop at their limits (disabled).
S25.14.where: Sidebar > Library > Images > click an image row, then use the Zoom group in the viewer top bar

S25.25.note: The Library viewer has no full-screen control. ArtifactPreview.tsx has a button with title Fullscreen and aria-label Enter fullscreen / Exit fullscreen (lines 2939 and 3568), but the path from Library to that panel was not confirmed.

S25.26.note: The top-bar button has only an icon and an aria-label; the visible words Download to view appear only when inline preview is unavailable.
steps: Sign in, then click Library in the sidebar.
Click a file row that opens the viewer, such as an image or PDF.
In the top bar, click the download icon (aria-label Download <file name>).
Look for the browser saving the original file with its own name and type.
S25.26.where: Sidebar > Library > click any previewable file row > Download button in the viewer top bar

S25.27.needs: a PDF or .docx file in the Library
S25.27.note: The button shows only when the text is loaded and the file is not already text/*.
steps: Sign in, then click Library in the sidebar.
Click the Documents tab and open a PDF or Word file so the text loads.
Hover the icon button in the top bar; its title is Download as text.
Click it and look for a .txt file saved with the extracted text.
S25.27.where: Sidebar > Library > Documents > click a PDF or .docx row > Download as text button in the viewer top bar

S25.28.needs: a file with text in the Library
S25.28.note: Searched LibraryView.tsx, FileTextPreview.tsx and FilePreviewModal.tsx for copy controls and user-select rules: no copy button or copy action found. Only the browser's own selection may apply.

S25.30.needs: a file with no inline preview (for example a .zip)
S25.30.note: Library rows open the viewer only when the file is previewable, so the fallback may show only if a preview fails to load; the Project settings viewer shows Preview is not available for this file type. instead (FilePreviewModal.tsx:440).
steps: Sign in, then click Library in the sidebar.
Click a file row that cannot be shown inline.
Look for the text Preview isn’t available for this file inline. with a Download to view button.
Click Download to view and check that the file downloads.
S25.30.where: Sidebar > Library > click a file row whose inline preview fails (no inline preview)
